name: Field Mechanic [Item Creation]
body:
You no longer require extensive resources to create mechanical marvels.

Prerequisite(s): Technologist, Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks, Craft (mechanical) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): When creating technological items, you no longer require a lab. However, if you craft a technological item without the use of the appropriate lab, the craft DC increases by 5.
